title: mncs-store persistence lifecycle still uses host publication mechanics
summary: Profile 0.18 now provides bounded file mutation, rename, directory creation, listing, deletion, and sync primitives. The remaining pressure is consumer cutover: mncs-store still makes its persistence lifecycle and publication path ordinary Python execution.
requiredBehavior: Move store persistence lifecycle policy and publication sequencing to MNCS using the current typed filesystem capabilities; retain host code only for external filesystem/process transport and explicit platform limitations.

observation.summary: Current consumer audit still finds os.replace, os.fsync, os.listdir, os.remove, and exclusive-create helpers on the ordinary store lifecycle path; the language capability is available but not consumed canonically.

reproduction.instructions: inspect the current store lifecycle and run its persistence tests against the Profile 0.18 capability boundary

evidence.summary: Host publication and durability helpers remain in the consumer lifecycle.

workaround.description: Python store driver remains the ordinary publication and durability implementation while native consumer cutover is pending.
